definition: to risk money on what will happen
description: At an outdoor skatepark in the evening, a young man in a rust T-shirt and jeans, one foot on a skateboard, laughs and shakes hands with a young woman with a blonde ponytail in a light blue crop top and matching trousers, her other hand on her hip. He points at a long flight of concrete stairs with a metal handrail, and after the handshake she points at him and then at the stairs, laughing. A few banknotes lie on the concrete ledge beside them. Other skaters stand at the top of the stairs.

en.question: What is the man pointing at?

phrases: llevar una camiseta de manga corta
es.question: ¿Qué está señalando el hombre?

phrases: porter un t-shirt à manches courtes
